name: info
title: network.info
lead: This server's network, by name, and the instance this pack runs on: `id` and the fields after it are nil on a server that is not one.
signature: network.info() → ({network: string, id: string ?, member: string ?, label: string ?, slots: number ?, data: any }?, string ?)
returns: ({network: string , id: string ?, member: string ?, label: string ?, slots: number ?, data: any }?, string ?)

usedIn.quote: - The name of the network sends the player to its default member. `network.info().network` is that name. `hub` is Minefort's hub.
local me = network.info()                 -- `me.id` is nil on a server that is not an instance

- `network.start{ member, label, slots, data? }` starts an instance of `member`. It returns `{id, state}` at once, with `state = "starting"`: the instance comes online later. `slots` is the number of players the instance takes. `data` is the pack's own value for the instance, read there with `network.info()`.
